title: Algebraic structures on digital objects
summary: The paper aims to introduce a digital-topological ($DT$-, for brevity) $k$-ring and a $DT$-$k$-field. They are indeed endowed with both a digital image (or digital object) $(X, k)$ and a ring structure or a field structure $(X, \ast_1, \star)$, where $X \subset {\mathbb Z}^n$ and the $k$-adjacency is the digital $k$-connectivity of ${\mathbb Z}^n$. Besides, some properties of them are investigated.
